text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while undergoing sprint-focused 
training in preparation for the Sprinters 
Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Same-Generation Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, did Flower get even faster? She's 
aiming for the Sprinters Stakes, right?

text_block_list.name: Same-Generation Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
With that kind of speed, she could easily 
hold her own against Senior-class 
runners...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... Trainer... How was it?
choice_data_list: Your times are steadily getting faster!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? Though I feel like my 
speed dropped toward the end...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Maybe my stamina just isn't keeping up 
after all? I should probably work out 
more, shouldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower doesn't seem very 
confident. The outcome of the Yushun Himba 
must still be weighing on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet her legs are growing sharper by the 
day. In order to make them realize 
that..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right around here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! Who was that! Who called for 
me?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san? Did you call for me...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Did I just hear you say, "With that 
speed, she can definitely hold her own in 
the Senior Class"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Speed equals Bakushin! Whoever called for 
me, please raise your hand, don't be shy!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Is this the wind's final destination? 
Please, let me join your circle as well."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Even you, Zephyr-san? Umm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O and Yamanin Zephyr. Both 
have declared their entry into the 
Sprinters Stakes, making them true rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are already excelling in 
sprints and miles. Running alongside them 
and improving her own performance should 
definitely boost Nishino Flower's 
confidence.
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask you two—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Towaaaaah!! Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh! The older girls really are fast! 
Their backs feel so far away... but!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to catch up...! Aaaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No way... Did I... win...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...To think the heat haze could be this 
intense.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! What magnificent speed! Miss 
Flower, that was a Nice Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...? Thank you very much♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Allow me to thank you as well. Now I'm 
looking forward to the Sprinters Stakes 
even more."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaah!? Could the two of you actually be 
rivals!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! But I just found out now! On the day 
of the race, I definitely won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower nodded firmly. It seemed 
she had gained a bit of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training is over, and evening has fallen. 
As for what comes next today...
choice_data_list:
Let's work on building the power to charge 
up hills.

Let's practice cheering you on so you can 
keep going till the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Nakayama Racecourse, the stage for the 
Sprinters Stakes, has a steep uphill right 
before the goal line. I want her to build 
the strength to overcome it."
choice_data_list: (In that case, I could use some advice...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hum-hum~♪ Bath time, bath time...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—That is correct. My father taught me that 
training method.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm? Bourbon and... her Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I turned to Mihono Bourbon for advice. I 
wanted to hear her take, as she seemed to 
have strong principles when it came to 
power training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Those are the key points of the slope 
training. For Flower, I recommend limiting 
the load to half.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Please take good care of Flower-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (...Trainer is still working hard for me.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, what matters most is 
willpower. They say cheers during a race 
give strength, so I wanted to learn some 
effective words of encouragement.
choice_data_list: (In that case, I could use some advice...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hum-hum~♪ Bath time, bath time...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing words like that gives me tons 
of energy!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm? Biko and... her Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I turned to Biko Pegasus for advice. I was 
curious to hear the opinion of someone who 
always energetically runs around for the 
sake of others.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
When I'm running, nothing beats 
straightforward cheers!
choice_data_list: Thank you, that really helped a lot!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
As a hero, I'm always fully prepared to 
cheer someone up! Feel free to count on me 
anytime!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (...Trainer is still working hard for me.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After gathering feedback from the 
Umamusume and putting it together, I took 
a stroll outside for a breather, when...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I found it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Right now! Do you have a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, here you go...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of the blue, Nishino Flower handed 
me... a warm rice ball and a thermos 
filled with miso soup.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Here's a midnight snack. Someone from the 
facility said it was okay for me to use 
the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I thought you might be getting 
hungry around about now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Um, was I being meddlesome?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Even though the nights are hot, 
warm foods are definitely easier on the 
stomach, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do my best again starting 
tomorrow! Let's definitely win the race, 
okay?
